content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NLUJA Lawyer Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 03-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NLUJA Lawyer Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the NLUJA Lawyer Fellow recruitment is 03 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Lawyer Fellow post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies announced for the Lawyer Fellow position at the National Law University and Judicial Academy.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the Lawyer Fellow position?
faq.answer: Candidates must be enrolled advocates with 2-5 years of continuous practice, currently practising in Assam, and have proven experience in litigation or legal aid work.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via email. Candidates need to send their complete application and documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the NLUJA Lawyer Fellow posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the NLUJA Lawyer Fellow recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Lawyer Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves application submission via email, followed by shortlisting, a two-stage interview (online and in-person), and final selection with a waitlist.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the National Law University and Judicial Academy located?
faq.answer: The National Law University and Judicial Academy is located in Guwahati, Assam, with the pincode 781031.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the Lawyer Fellow position?
faq.answer: The Lawyer Fellow position is a contractual job type.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age limit restrictions for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limits for the Lawyer Fellow position. Candidates are advised to check the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q10. When will the orientation and commencement of the program take place?
faq.answer: The orientation and commencement of the Lawyer Fellow program are tentatively scheduled for 01 November 2026.
